hints.title: Partition Sum of Averages
hints.text: Divide the sequence into contiguous segments to maximize the cumulative group averages.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Optimization
hints.text: Compute prefix sums to calculate the average of any subarray in constant time.

hints.title: Group Count State Extension
hints.text: Define state dp[i][p] as the maximum average sum using p partitions on prefix up to i, iterating partition boundaries j from p - 1 to i - 1.

complexity.notes: 1D rolling DP table with prefix sum subarray queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all C(N - 1, k - 1) partition combinations takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling 1D array of size N reduces space from O(k * N) to O(N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use prefix sums for constant-time subarray average calculation and roll DP state.
